answer: Each new agent identity must register at the beacon by locking 200 tokens, and the lockup fee doubles with every additional identity tied to the same hardware fingerprint—so forging 10 identities costs 200+400+...+102,400 ≈ 204,600 tokens (quadratic scaling). Identities in the orchard earn vouching weight only after 30 days of uptime, and any agent caught using a forged attestation from a compromised forge node is slashed 90% of all its bonds.
